title: Homestead 2D: farm, endless map, two players
summary: A finished-feeling painted top-down homestead (craft2d): an endless seeded land that changes region as you walk out, crops to till, sow, water and harvest, crafting, building with stairs and decks, needs, day and night, a trading post, quests that teach the loop, saving, touch controls, and one shared world for two players (lobbyUI, GCP.room, createWorldSync). src/theme.js holds the whole game's content; src/main.js is the engine. Its play-through checks everything, a second player included. design_scene hands it out for 2D briefs with farming, an expanding map or multiplayer.
